_comment: Data-driven synonym GROUPS for curriculum-topic matching. Each inner list holds phrasings treated as fully interchangeable for matching purposes -- illustrative starter set only, matching the spec's own test examples. Deliberately EXCLUDES modified/broader forms (e.g. 'Advanced Data Structures', 'Data Structures and Algorithms') -- those are NOT synonyms of the base term and must not be added here; see the compound-concept and partial-relationship handling in core_knowledge_mapping.py instead.
_scope_comment: Discipline keys (slugs of the discipline name recorded in the pipeline source manifest) this vocabulary applies to. The scoped loader (load_scoped_vocabulary) only applies it to topics from these disciplines, so e.g. 'CN' is never expanded to 'Computer Networks' inside a Chemical Engineering curriculum. Adding vocabulary for a new discipline = adding a new file under reference_data/vocab/, never code.
